//: What checks the interface without changing the language it is written in.
Every exported function here already says in its documentation comment what
it takes and what it answers with, and this is what reads those as types.
Nothing is compiled: noEmit, because what ships is built by esbuild out of
strict is off for now. The interface talks to a service whose answers are
read as objects, and turning it on would mean a type for every one of those
before a single real mistake is caught. What is on is the part that finds
mistakes in code that is already written: a name that does not exist on a
